This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER
The applicant has filed this repeat (2nd) bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C.
His first bail application was dismissed on merits on 4.1.2023 after considering the fact that the FSL report came positive against the present applicant.

The applicant is in custody since 18.8.2022 in connection with FIR/Crime No.767/2022 registered at Police Station Majhouli District Sidhi for the offences punishable under Sections 376, 450, 506 of IPC.
The allegation against the present applicant is that he entered into the house of the prosecutrix on 17/8/2022 at around 3:00 PM and committed rape on her.
The FIR was lodged in the morning of the next day i.e. 18/8/2022.

Considering the aforesaid, this application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance on the dates given by the concerned Court.

It is further directed that the applicant shall also comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
